value: Grew fat on the morgue's leftovers and never stopped growing. The fastest thing on four legs, as long as you don't ask it to carry much.

value: It takes its time. All of it. Whatever you load arrives eventually, and it leaves a shiny trail to find your way back.

value: It came up out of the cemetery one rainy night and decided to stay. Best not to ask what it was eating down there.
